summary: Boundary County crow's nest in the Kaniksu NF, set up in the 1930s and abandoned in 1942; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1942. No source says whether any structure remains.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the entry 'Hike-In Abandoned'. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Crow's nest. The sources say only 'the 1930s'; 1930 stands in for the decade.
Both lookout sites give 1942 as the year it was abandoned.

evidence.supports: Kaniksu National Forest; 14 miles east of Bonners Ferry
evidence.quote: Kaniksu National Forest 14 miles east of Bonners Ferry

evidence.supports: association list: Crowsnest kind, Abandoned status

corrections.why: All three sources say the crow's nest was abandoned in 1942. None says the structure was removed or fell down, so 'gone' is not supported.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three sites agree on a 1930s crow's nest and a 1942 abandonment, and none describes the site after that. No staffing, fire or access-closure sources were found. The brief's two coordinate pairs are about 670 m apart (FFLA 48.57299, -116.06616; Idaho Fire Lookouts 48.56794, -116.07118). The record's 'gone' status is not supported and is proposed as 'unknown'.
